result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide sidewalk equipped with a curb ramp and pedestrian signals, indicating basic infrastructure is present. However, the walkway is significantly cluttered by poorly placed utility poles and debris, which obstruct the clear path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility and traffic signal poles are located in the middle of the walking path, reducing the effective width and creating obstacles for those with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Debris on Walkway
hazards.description: A large wooden pole or log is lying across a portion of the sidewalk, creating a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right of the traffic signal pole on the sidewalk

interventions.title: Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility and signal poles to a dedicated furniture zone at the edge of the sidewalk to maintain a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Maintenance and Debris Removal
interventions.description: Remove the fallen log and other debris to ensure a clear and safe walking surface for all users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway lacking sufficient crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk and a faded crosswalk on a side street are present, the main thoroughfare presents a significant barrier with long crossing distances and no visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings on the side street are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground crossing the side street

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The main roadway is exceptionally wide, requiring pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any mid-crossing refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main thoroughfare

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Utility Poles
hazards.description: Large utility poles at the corner may partially block sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for drivers on both the main and side streets.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island on the main roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with a high degree of pedestrian exposure due to the expansive crossing distance. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the lack of physical protection such as refuge islands and the faded state of crosswalk markings create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic at once, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk lines are significantly degraded, making the pedestrian zone less visible to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder-style markings to improve the visibility of the crossing area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce the total crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked crosswalk and curb ramps with tactile warnings, but the environment is dominated by wide asphalt and industrial land use. Faded pavement markings and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals increase risk for those crossing the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
